about:
I am a Developer with expertise in Java (Spring Boot), Node.js, and PHP (Laravel). My experience spans backend architecture, API development, cloud services, and frontend technologies like React.

🔹 What I Do:
✅ Build and optimize scalable backend systems with a focus on performance and security.
✅ Develop RESTful APIs and microservices, ensuring seamless integration between services.
✅ Work with AWS (EC2, RDS), Docker, and Kubernetes to deploy and maintain cloud-based solutions.
✅ Design and develop frontend applications using React and TailwindCSS for freelance projects.
✅ Improve database performance and scalability, implementing indexing, caching, and query optimizations.

🎯 My Goals:
🚀 Build robust and scalable software solutions for businesses and clients.
💡 Stay updated with the latest trends in cloud computing, DevOps, and fullstack development.
📈 Expand my expertise in high-performance systems and distributed architectures.
